basis: Read-only preregistration supplement; no baseline model, mature outcomes, fit permission or family budget is assumed

design.hypothesis: Source-timed operating candidates may add information to the SAME frozen price-volume baseline; no improvement assumed
design.event: Bind original frozen positive20-session RAW round-trip net-return label; unresolved outcomes remain missing
design.same_sample_controls: Identical company/date/label/cost/execution cohort and timestamps; retain missing indicators; no selective complete-case deletion or stock/date search

time_out_windows.rule: Chronological development/calibration/out-of-time windows fixed BEFORE any labels;20-session purge and embargo; no shuffled split; unbound windows prohibit execution

scoring.log_loss: -mean(y*log(p)+(1-y)*log(1-p)); same predeclared numerical clipping as baseline
scoring.calibration: Fixed five equal-width reliability bins; disclose support/uncertainty; missing outcomes are not negatives
scoring.comparison: Paired same-sample differences versus original frozen baseline and development base rate; cluster dependent overlapping events and issuer disclosure roots

costs.rule: Same source-bound historical statutory/broker/slippage/corporate-action treatment as baseline; unknown is not zero; report fees and turnover

design.risk_exposure_controls: Matched gross/net/industry/size/beta exposures, drawdown and turnover; separate timing from sector/exposure effects, no unqualified excess-return claim

maturity.label_rule: Only actual completed20-session outcomes under identical frozen event; later revisions cannot alter historical features
maturity.independence: Issuer/origin-root/reporting-period clusters; repeated quarterly reports/dailies/A-H listings do not add independent operating evidence

stopping.budget: Existing family residual budget INCLUDING prior failed/aborted attempts and reservations; NEVER reset or allocate here
stopping.no_new_fit_without: Explicit fitting authorization AND frozen fully bound supplement AND unchanged original family budget gates
stopping.evidence_deadline: Inherit original calendar deadline, never restart it for this entry
stopping.insufficient: INCONCLUSIVE at insufficient support/deadline; preserve all failures, no retuning/search to obtain PASS
